patches.source: Connect native application-handler plumbing; opt-in only
Expose canonical Session context on authenticated inbound connection events
Project application-owned conversations and sessions into rvoip orchestration
Let exact SIP terminal signaling win a normal remote-hangup media closure race
Expose opt-in audio queue ceilings through core orchestration and raw QUIC stream construction; preserve upstream defaults.
Opt-in SIP and WebRTC frame queue caps with construction tests; preserve existing 64-frame defaults.
Opt-in authenticated envelope policy on SessionBindingResolver, before correlation/application/resource mutation; default preserves existing resolver behavior.

Opt-in host-owned Vapi call admission after request preparation and immediately before REST send; default unchanged. Connect uses current atomic task/session admission; no duplicate possibly-sent creation.
Add bounded encoded-video forwarding and RTP-preserving QUIC/WebRTC streams; audio retains its compatibility path.
Opt-in current-authority durable Session retirement preserves physical peer control and other Sessions; default peer revocation guard unchanged, unknown/revoked/storage failures remain fail-closed.
Bound opt-in terminal Session wire/event delivery concurrently within two seconds and current-peer abort/guard error within an absolute three-second budget; saturated queue regressions.

Bind negotiated receiver-report and transport-wide congestion feedback when the first RTP packet resolves an SDP-declared SSRC codec; preserve per-stream loss history and reject unnegotiated codec binding.
